metadata.title: ALVOXIS Flow
metadata.description: Invoicing, inventory, production and payroll for small and medium businesses in the Baltics and Poland.

environment.label: Test environment
environment.testBanner: Not production. Use synthetic data only: no real invoices, customers or bank details.

dashboard.title: Dashboard
dashboard.subtitle: Overview of your company's documents and operations.

documents.title: Documents
documents.unavailable: Documents are not available with your role, or until two-factor authentication is set up.
documents.currencyNote: Totals are shown per document currency and are never added across currencies.
documents.loadError: The document figures could not be loaded right now. Your documents are not affected; try again later.
documents.paymentsNotTracked: Payments are not tracked yet, so nothing here shows what is paid, outstanding or overdue.

notFound.title: Page not found
notFound.description: The page you are looking for does not exist or has been moved.

errorPage.title: Something went wrong
errorPage.description: The page could not be shown. Please try again. If it keeps happening, tell us the error code.

offline.title: You are offline

email.footer: This message was sent by ALVOXIS Flow. If you did not expect it, you can ignore it.

verify.subject: Confirm your email address

reset.subject: Reset your password

existingAccount.subject: Sign-up attempt with your email address
existingAccount.body:
Someone tried to create a new ALVOXIS Flow account with this email address, but you already have an account. If this was you, sign in or reset your password here:
{link}

newSignIn.subject: New sign-in to your account

passwordChanged.subject: Your password was changed
passwordChanged.body:
Your ALVOXIS Flow password was changed on {time} (UTC) and your other sessions were signed out. If you did not do this, reset your password immediately:
{link}

twoFactorEnabled.subject: Two-factor authentication enabled
twoFactorEnabled.body: Two-factor authentication was enabled for your ALVOXIS Flow account on {time} (UTC). Keep your recovery codes in a safe place. If this was not you, contact your administrator immediately.

twoFactorDisabled.subject: Two-factor authentication disabled
twoFactorDisabled.body:
Two-factor authentication was disabled for your ALVOXIS Flow account on {time} (UTC). If this was not you, change your password immediately:
{link}

signInLocked.subject: Several failed sign-in attempts
signInLocked.body:
Password sign-in to your ALVOXIS Flow account was paused for 15 minutes after several failed attempts on {time} (UTC). Devices you have signed in from before can still sign in. If this was not you, reset your password:
{link}

signIn.title: Sign in
signIn.subtitle: Welcome back to ALVOXIS Flow.
signIn.verified: Your email address is confirmed. You can sign in now.
signIn.verifyFailed: The confirmation link is invalid or has expired. Sign in to request a new one.
signIn.resetDone: Your password was changed. Sign in with the new password.
signIn.resent: If the account exists and is not yet confirmed, a new confirmation email has been sent.

signUp.title: Create your account
signUp.subtitle: Start using ALVOXIS Flow.
signUp.passwordHint: At least {min} characters. A long passphrase is easiest to remember.

checkEmail.title: Check your email
checkEmail.body: If {email} can be used for a new account, we have sent a confirmation link to it. Open the link to activate your account. It expires in 24 hours.

forgot.title: Reset your password
forgot.subtitle: Enter your email and we will send you a reset link.
forgot.sent: If an account exists for this email, a reset link has been sent. It expires in 1 hour.

reset.title: Choose a new password
reset.invalid: This reset link is invalid or has expired.

twoFactor.title: Two-factor verification
twoFactor.subtitle: Enter the 6-digit code from your authenticator app.
twoFactor.stepUp: Your account uses two-factor authentication. Confirm this session to continue.
twoFactor.useTotp: Use a code from the authenticator app
twoFactor.recoverySubtitle: Enter one of the recovery codes you saved when setting up two-factor authentication. Each code works once.
twoFactor.lostAccess: Lost both your authenticator and your recovery codes? Contact ALVOXIS Flow support; your identity will be verified before two-factor authentication is reset.

setup.title: Set up two-factor authentication
setup.intro: A code from an authenticator app (for example Google Authenticator, Microsoft Authenticator or 1Password) will be required when you sign in.
setup.required: Your role requires two-factor authentication before you can access company data.
setup.step2: Scan this QR code with your authenticator app
setup.manual: Cannot scan it? Enter this key manually:
setup.step3: Enter the 6-digit code shown in the app
setup.recoveryBody: Each code can be used once if you lose access to your authenticator. Store them somewhere safe and private — they will not be shown again.
setup.qrAlt: QR code for your authenticator app

security.title: Security
security.subtitle: Password, two-factor authentication and active sessions.
security.passwordChanged: Password changed. All other sessions were signed out.
security.disableHelp: Enter your password to disable two-factor authentication.
security.requiredForRole: Required for your role — it cannot be disabled.
security.regenerateHelp: Enter your password. The current recovery codes will stop working.
security.regenerated: Your new recovery codes (the previous ones no longer work):
security.sessionsSubtitle: Devices currently signed in to your account.
security.revokedOthers: {count, plural, one {# session was signed out.} other {# sessions were signed out.}}
security.emailNotConfigured: Email delivery is not configured on this server, so security notifications such as new sign-in alerts are not being sent. An administrator must configure email delivery.

errors.emailNotVerified: Please confirm your email address first — check your inbox for the confirmation link.
errors.passwordTooShort: The password must be at least {min} characters.
errors.invalidToken: This link is invalid or has expired.
errors.invalidCode: The code is not correct. Check that the time on your device is correct and try again.
errors.codeUsed: This code has already been used. Wait for the next code.
errors.tooManyRequests: Too many attempts. Please wait a moment and try again.
errors.locked: Too many failed attempts. Try again later.
errors.requiredForRole: Your role requires two-factor authentication, so it cannot be disabled.
errors.emailNotConfigured: Email delivery is not configured on this server, so confirmation and password-reset emails cannot be sent. Please contact the administrator.
errors.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.

onboarding.createCompanyBody: Add your company to start working with documents. You will become its owner.
onboarding.twoFactorRequiredBody: Owners and administrators must set up two-factor authentication before they can access company data.

company.title: Company profile
company.description: Identification details used for your company, for example as the seller on documents.
company.readOnly: You can view this profile. Only owners and administrators can change it.
company.name: Display name
company.countryHint: Set when the company was created; it cannot be changed here.
company.vatNumberHint: Optional. Starts with the country code, e.g. {prefix}. Only the format is checked, not registration.
company.forbidden: You do not have permission to change this profile.
company.twoFactorRequired: Your role requires two-factor authentication before you can open company data.
company.error: Something went wrong. Please try again.

fieldError.name: Enter a name (up to 200 characters).
fieldError.registrationNumber: Use letters, digits, spaces, dots, slashes or dashes (up to 32 characters).
fieldError.vatNumber: Use the country code followed by 2–12 letters or digits.

documents.title: Documents
documents.description: Invoices, proforma invoices, credit notes and delivery notes of this company.
documents.empty: There are no documents in this company yet.
documents.issuedNotice: This document is issued as No. <num>{number}</num>. Issued documents cannot be edited.
documents.readOnlyDraft: You can view this draft. Your role cannot change it.
documents.sellerHint: The seller details come from the company profile.
documents.name: Name
documents.unsaved: You have unsaved changes. Save the draft before issuing it.
documents.totalsPending: Totals appear when the draft has no errors.
documents.issueConfirmBody: The next number in the series is assigned and the content is frozen. An issued document cannot be edited or deleted.
documents.issueBlocked: The document cannot be issued yet. Fix the problems listed below.
documents.invalid: The draft was not saved. Fix the problems listed below.

outcome.conflict: This draft was changed elsewhere, for example in another tab. Reload it to continue; changes made here and not saved will be lost.
outcome.notDraft: This document has already been issued. Reload to see it.
outcome.state: This action is not possible for this document.
outcome.signedOut: Your session has ended. Please sign in again.
outcome.twoFactor: Your role requires two-factor authentication for this action.
outcome.forbidden: You do not have permission for this action, or the company is no longer active.
outcome.error: Something went wrong. Please try again.

taxCategory.archived: This tax category is archived. Choose an active category.
taxCategory.unlinked: This line's tax category was entered before the company's tax category list existed. Choose a category from the list.

id.duplicate: Two lines have the same identifier.

quantity.mustBePositive: Delivery note quantities must be positive.

kind.invalid: The tax treatment is not valid.

note.recommended: Add a note explaining the tax treatment.

validUntil.onlyForProforma: “Valid until” is only used on proforma invoices.

name.required: The company name is missing in the company profile.

address.required: The company address is missing in the company profile.

iban.invalid: A bank account IBAN is not valid.

bankAccount.missing: No bank account is shown on the document.
bankAccount.unknown: The chosen bank account does not exist in this company.
bankAccount.archived: The bank account of this draft is archived. Choose another account or none before issuing.

lines.tooMany: The document has too many lines.

exchangeRate.currencyMismatch: The exchange rate does not match the document currency.

flags.unresolved: Some findings of the import have not been checked yet.

duplicates.unacknowledged: Confirm the possible duplicate before creating a draft.

documents.archivedWarning: This category is archived. Choose an active category before issuing.
documents.legacyWarning: Tax details entered before the company's category list: {details}. They are kept when you save, but choose a category from the list before issuing.
documents.noCategoriesManage: This company has no tax categories yet. Add the categories confirmed by your company or accountant before issuing documents with prices.
documents.noCategoriesAsk: This company has no tax categories yet. Ask an owner, administrator or accountant to add them.

new.title: New document
new.hint: The seller details come from the company profile. Lines and tax categories are added in the editor after the draft is created.
new.invalid: The draft was not created. Please check the fields.

documents.deleteConfirmBody: The draft is deleted permanently. Issued documents cannot be deleted.
documents.deleteConfirmBodyEditor: The draft is deleted permanently and cannot be restored. All unsaved changes in this editor will be lost. Issued documents cannot be deleted.
documents.creditNoteBank: Credit notes keep the bank details of the original invoice.

creditNote.title: Credit note for invoice {number}
creditNote.description: Creates a credit note draft that you can check in the editor before issuing it. The invoice itself is never changed.

full.label: Everything that remains
full.hint: Credits every invoice line that has not been credited yet.

partial.label: Selected lines
partial.hint: Credits only the quantities you enter below.

creditNote.linesHint: Leave a line empty to skip it. Quantities already credited by issued credit notes are checked when the draft is created.
creditNote.refused: The credit note draft was not created.
creditNote.notCreditable: Only an issued invoice can be credited.

errors.dateBeforeInvoice: The credit note date cannot be earlier than the invoice date.
errors.noLines: Enter a quantity for at least one line.
errors.quantityInvalid: Enter a number greater than zero with at most 4 decimal places.
errors.quantityTooHigh: This is more than the invoiced quantity.

pdf.draftHint: The draft PDF is marked “not issued” and has no number.
pdf.unsaved: The PDF shows the last saved version. Save the draft to include your changes.

entry.title: Documents
entry.choose: Choose a company to open its documents.
entry.none: Documents belong to a company. Create your company first.

filters.noMatches: No documents match your search or filters.
filters.amountSortHint: Amounts are sorted within each currency; drafts have no total yet and come last.

related.empty: No credit notes for this invoice yet.
related.loadError: The credit notes of this invoice could not be loaded. Reload the page to try again.

import.title: Import a PDF invoice
import.description: Read an invoice PDF of your company and check the extracted data before a draft is created.
import.fileHint: A text-based PDF up to {size} MB and 20 pages. Scanned images cannot be read yet.
import.privacy: The file is read on our server only to extract the data, is not stored and is not sent to any other service.
import.tooLarge: The file is larger than {size} MB.
import.notPdf: This file is not a PDF.
import.unreadable: The PDF could not be read. Scanned documents without a text layer are not supported yet.
import.fileRead: {name}: {pages, plural, one {# page} other {# pages}} read
import.findingsHint: Check each finding below before a draft can be created.
import.duplicatesTitle: A similar document may already exist in this company:
import.duplicateConfirm: I have checked the existing document and still want to create a new draft.
import.numberHint: Read from the file for reference; the draft gets its own number when it is issued.
import.sellerFixed: Seller: your company ({name}), from the company profile.
import.taxHint: Tax treatment is never taken from the file: choose the category for the lines explicitly. You can change it per line in the editor.
import.noCategories: Add a tax category before importing.
import.noLines: No lines were found in the file.
import.totalsHint: For comparison only: the draft's totals are calculated from its lines.
import.statementsTitle: Text that may have tax or legal meaning
import.statementsHint: Shown for your attention; it is not interpreted.

problems.lines: Every line needs a description, a quantity other than zero and a unit price.

amount.ambiguous: An amount can be read in more than one way (e.g. 1,234). Check the numbers.

bankAccount.ibanInvalid: An IBAN in the file has an invalid checksum.

buyer.notFound: The buyer was not found in the file.

currency.multiple: More than one currency appears in the file.
currency.notFound: No currency was found in the file.

date.formatAmbiguous: A date can be read in more than one way (e.g. 02/03/2026). Check the dates.

documentType.unknown: The document type was not recognised.

dueDate.beforeIssueDate: The due date is before the issue date.

duplicate.possible: A similar document may already exist in this company.

file.noTextLayer: The file has no text layer (it looks like a scan) and cannot be read.

identifier.labelMismatch: A registration or VAT number does not match its label.
identifier.unlabelled: A number that may be a registration or VAT number has no label.

issueDate.unlabelled: The issue date was taken from a date without a label.

seller.notFound: The seller was not found in the file.

statements.found: The file contains text that may have tax or legal meaning (shown below).

tax.notShown: No tax amount is shown in the file.
tax.treatmentRequiresConfirmation: Tax treatment is never taken from the file: choose a tax category.
tax.zeroRateUnexplained: A 0 % tax rate is shown without an explanation.

totals.linesMismatch: The lines do not add up to the printed subtotal.
totals.sumMismatch: Subtotal and tax do not add up to the printed total.

taxCategories.title: Tax categories
taxCategories.description: Tax categories this company uses on documents.
taxCategories.noRatesProvided: ALVOXIS Flow does not supply tax rates or rules. Enter only the categories confirmed by your company or accountant.
taxCategories.readOnly: You can view the tax categories. Owners, administrators and accountants can change them.

fields.codeHint: Short identifier. It cannot be changed later.
fields.rateHint: Use 0 for treatments other than the standard rate. The rate cannot be changed later; a different rate needs a new category.
fields.label: Name on documents
fields.noteHint: For example the basis of an exemption, as provided by your accountant.

taxCategories.immutableHint: Code, treatment and rate cannot be changed. For a different rate or treatment, add a new category and archive this one.
taxCategories.archiveConfirmBody: It will no longer be offered for new lines. Drafts that already use it cannot be issued until another category is chosen. Issued documents do not change.
